items.title_cn: 高脂血症性急性胰腺炎中C反应蛋白-甘油三酯-葡萄糖指数究竟是谁的信号？
items.title_en: Whose Signal Is It Anyway? The C-Reactive Protein–Triglyceride–Glucose Index in Hyperlipidemic Acute Pancreatitis
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题涉及高脂血症性急性胰腺炎中的C反应蛋白-甘油三酯-葡萄糖指数，但提供的摘要内容为空，无法总结核心发现。

items.title_cn: RNA结合蛋白EIF3B通过稳定RIPK3 mRNA促进急性胰腺炎坏死性凋亡及继发性代谢性酸中毒
items.title_en: The RNA-binding protein EIF3B promotes necroptosis and subsequent metabolic acidosis in acute pancreatitis through stabilization of RIPK3 mRNA
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题表明EIF3B通过稳定RIPK3 mRNA促进坏死性凋亡，进而导致急性胰腺炎中的代谢性酸中毒。由于未提供摘要，无法总结更多具体发现。

items.title_cn: SAP衍生外泌体通过FKBP5介导抑制RIPK3/MLKL信号促进肠道屏障损伤
items.title_en: SAP ‐Derived Exosomes Promote Intestinal Barrier Injury Through FKBP5‐Mediated Suppression of RIPK 3/ MLKL Signaling
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 探讨循环外泌体在重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）肠道屏障功能障碍中的作用，并阐明其潜在分子机制，重点关注Fkbp5介导的RIPK3/MLKL坏死性凋亡信号通路抑制。从早期SAP患者和健康对照者中分离血清外泌体，并通过透射电子显微镜（TEM）和纳米颗粒跟踪分析（NTA）进行表征。通过反复腹腔注射雨蛙素后给予脂多糖（LPS）诱导SAP小鼠模型，并进行外泌体释放抑制剂GW4869、Fkbp5抑制剂SAFit2和RIPK3抑制剂GSK872的干预实验。采用组织学染色、免疫组织化学、血清生物标志物检测、肠道通透性试验和转录组测序评估外泌体和Fkbp5对SAP相关肠道损伤的影响。在GW4869处理后进行外泌体再回输实验，并通过E-钙黏蛋白双重免疫荧光染色评估膜相关p-MLKL。SAP患者血清外泌体水平显著升高。来自SAP小鼠的循环外泌体促进肠上皮屏障破坏和炎症反应。GW4869治疗显著改善胰腺和肠道组织病理学损伤，降低血清炎症标志物和肠道通透性，并下调肠道组织中Fkbp5表达。转录组分析和qRT-PCR验证显示，Fkbp5在SAP小鼠肠道中显著上调。抑制Fkbp5可恢复RIPK3和MLKL的磷酸化，减轻SAP小鼠的肠道损伤，而FKBP12抑制未产生保护作用。在体外，SAP来源的外泌体抑制肠上皮细胞中的坏死性凋亡信号，而GW4869逆转了这种抑制。再回输SAP来源的外泌体（而非对照来源的外泌体）部分恢复了GW4869治疗后的胰腺和肠道损伤，伴随肠道FKBP5表达增加、Occludin和Claudin-1表达降低以及膜相关p-MLKL减少。此外，GSK872抑制RIPK3加重了SAP小鼠的胰腺和肠道损伤。这些发现表明，重症急性胰腺炎中的循环外泌体可能上调Fkbp5，从而抑制坏死性凋亡通路并由此破坏肠道稳态。SAP中的循环外泌体通过上调Fkbp5加剧肠道屏障功能障碍，而Fkbp5抑制RIPK3/MLKL坏死性凋亡信号通路。靶向外泌体-Fkbp5轴可能为SAP相关肠道损伤提供治疗策略。
items.abstract_en: ABSTRACT To investigate the role of circulating exosomes in intestinal barrier dysfunction during severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) and to elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms, with a particular focus on Fkbp5‐mediated suppression of RIPK3/MLKL necroptotic signaling. Serum exosomes were isolated from early‐stage SAP patients and healthy controls and characterized by transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and nanoparticle tracking analysis (NTA). A mouse model of SAP was induced by repeated intraperitoneal injections of caerulein followed by lipopolysaccharide (LPS) administration, and interventions with the exosome release inhibitor GW4869, the Fkbp5 inhibitor SAFit2, and the RIPK3 inhibitor GSK872 were performed. Histological staining, immunohistochemistry, serum biomarker assays, intestinal permeability tests, and transcriptomic sequencing were used to evaluate the effects of exosomes and Fkbp5 on intestinal injury associated with SAP. An exosome readministration experiment was performed after GW4869 treatment, and membrane‐associated p‐MLKL was assessed by dual immunofluorescence staining with E‐cadherin. Serum exosome levels were significantly elevated in SAP patients. Circulating exosomes from SAP mice promoted intestinal epithelial barrier disruption and inflammatory responses. GW4869 treatment significantly improved pancreatic and intestinal histopathological injury, reduced serum inflammatory markers and intestinal permeability, and downregulated Fkbp5 expression in intestinal tissues. Transcriptomic analysis and qRT‐PCR validation revealed that Fkbp5 was markedly upregulated in the intestines of SAP mice. Inhibition of Fkbp5 restored the phosphorylation of RIPK3 and MLKL, attenuating intestinal injury in SAP mice, while FKBP12 inhibition conferred no protective effect. In vitro, SAP‐derived exosomes suppressed necroptosis signaling in intestinal epithelial cells, whereas GW4869 reversed this suppression. Readministration of SAP‐derived, but not control‐derived, exosomes partially restored pancreatic and intestinal injury after GW4869 treatment, accompanied by increased intestinal FKBP5 expression, reduced Occludin and Claudin‐1 expression, and decreased membrane‐associated p‐MLKL. Furthermore, inhibition of RIPK3 by GSK872 aggravated pancreatic and intestinal injury in SAP mice. These findings suggest that circulating exosomes in severe acute pancreatitis may upregulate Fkbp5, thereby suppressing the necroptotic pathway and consequently disrupting intestinal homeostasis. Circulating exosomes in SAP exacerbate intestinal barrier dysfunction by upregulating Fkbp5, which suppresses the RIPK3/MLKL necroptotic signaling pathway. Targeting the exosome‐Fkbp5 axis may offer a therapeutic strategy for SAP‐related intestinal injury.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）患者血清外泌体水平显著升高，SAP来源的外泌体通过上调肠道Fkbp5表达、抑制RIPK3/MLKL坏死性凋亡信号通路，导致肠道屏障功能障碍；靶向外泌体-Fkbp5轴可能为SAP相关肠损伤提供治疗策略。

items.title_cn: 重复检测会改变结局吗？评估急性胰腺炎中系列酶水平的价值
items.title_en: Does Repeat Testing Change Outcomes? Assessing the Value of Serial Enzyme Levels in Acute Pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 引言：急性胰腺炎是胰腺的炎症性疾病，伴或不伴纤维化。淀粉酶和脂肪酶在急性胰腺炎的诊断中发挥重要作用。本研究旨在确定在初步诊断后进行胰酶测定的重要性。方法：本前瞻性队列观察研究在沙特阿拉伯法赫德国王医院开展。数据通过观察在单中心从参与者中收集，并使用SPSS软件进行分析。结果：本研究纳入184名参与者（47.8%为女性），平均年龄42.1岁，平均体重指数27.5。胆源性胰腺炎是急性胰腺炎最常见的病因（62.0%）。此外，初始实验室检查结果包括淀粉酶（54.9%的患者进行了该项检查）、淀粉酶和脂肪酶两者（38.6%）以及单独脂肪酶（6.5%）。在参与者中，75%接受了重复酶测定，16.8%的参与者被归类为可能为重症胰腺炎。结论：重复酶测定与较长的住院时间和较高的重症监护室入住可能性相关，强调了该亚组中疾病的潜在严重性。未来需要更大队列的研究来验证这些发现，并探索可能影响该患者群体重复酶测定需求/频率的其他因素。
items.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Acute pancreatitis is an inflammatory disorder of the pancreas, with or without fibrosis. Amylase and lipase play important roles in the diagnosis of acute pancreatitis. This study aimed to determine the importance of performing pancreatic enzyme measurements after initial diagnosis. METHODS: This prospective cohort observational study was conducted at King Fahad Hospital in Saudi Arabia. Data were collected from participants at a single center through observation and analysis using the SPSS software. RESULTS: This study enrolled 184 participants (47.8% females) with an average age of 42.1 years and an average body mass index of 27.5. Biliary pancreatitis was found to be the most common cause of acute pancreatitis (62.0%). Moreover, initial laboratory test results included amylase (performed in 54.9% of patients), both amylase and lipase (38.6%), and lipase alone (6.5%). Among the participants, 75% underwent repeated enzyme measurements, and severe pancreatitis was classified as likely in 16.8% of participants. CONCLUSION: Repeated enzyme measurements were associated with longer hospital stays and a higher likelihood of intensive care unit admission, emphasizing the potential severity of the disease in this subgroup. Future studies with larger cohorts are warranted to validate these findings and to explore additional factors that may influence the need/frequency for repeated enzyme measurements in this patient population.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现急性胰腺炎患者中75%接受了重复胰酶检测，重复检测与更长的住院时间和更高的ICU入住率相关，提示该亚组患者疾病可能更严重。胆源性胰腺炎是最常见病因（62.0%）。

items.title_cn: 预测急性胰腺炎患者严重程度和死亡率的预后模型——系统综述与荟萃分析
items.title_en: Prognostic Models for Predicting the Severity and Mortality in People With Acute Pancreatitis – A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.abstract_cn: 引言：急性胰腺炎是一种常见疾病，临床评分系统用于识别可能发展为重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）的患者。主要目的是评估Ranson、Glasgow-Imrie、急性生理与慢性健康评估（APACHE II）以及急性胰腺炎床旁严重度指数（BISAP）评分系统预测SAP和死亡率的准确性。材料与方法：对多个电子数据库进行了检索，我们纳入了所有报告以下一种或多种评分系统在成人入院48小时内准确性数据的研究：Ranson、Glasgow-Imrie、APACHE II和BISAP。我们纳入了报告SAP结局（器官衰竭≥48小时）或死亡率的研究。确定了各评分在不同时间点的曲线下面积（AUC）的荟萃分析汇总值。结果：共纳入87项研究，包含92个患者队列（65,942名参与者）。各评分系统（及时间点）预测SAP的最高汇总AUC分别为：Glasgow-Imrie（48小时内）0.88（0.83-0.92），Ranson（48小时内）0.87（0.81-0.91），BISAP（24小时内）0.85（0.82-0.88），APACHE II（24小时内）0.82（0.78-0.85）。各评分系统预测死亡率的最高汇总AUC分别为：BISAP（24小时内）0.89（0.84-0.92），Glasgow-Imrie（入院时）0.88（0.81-0.93），APACHE II（24小时内）0.86（0.84-0.89），Ranson（48小时内）0.86（0.81-0.90）。结论：没有证据表明这四种评分系统中任何一种在预测SAP或死亡率方面优于其他评分系统。其准确性随评分执行时间的不同而变化。
items.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Acute pancreatitis is a common condition, and clinical scoring systems are used to identify patients who may develop severe acute pancreatitis (SAP). The primary aim was to assess the accuracy of Ranson, Glasgow-Imrie, acute physiology and chronic health evaluation (APACHE II), and bedside index of severity in acute pancreatitis (BISAP) scoring systems for predicting SAP and mortality. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A search of multiple electronic databases was conducted, and we included all studies that reported accuracy data for one or more of the following scoring systems for adults within 48 h of admission; Ranson, Glasgow-Imrie, APACHE II, and BISAP. We included studies that reported the outcome of SAP (organ failure ≥48 h) or mortality. The meta-analytical summary of the area under the curve (AUC) for each score at different time points was determined. RESULTS: Eighty-seven studies that included 92 patient cohorts (65,942 participants) were included. The highest pooled AUC for each scoring system (and time point) in predicting SAP were 0.88 (0.83-0.92) for Glasgow-Imrie (within 48 h), 0.87 (0.81-0.91) for ranson (within 48 h), 0.85 (0.82-0.88) for BISAP (within 24 h), and 0.82 (0.78-0.85) for APACHE II (within 24 h). The highest pooled AUC for each scoring system in predicting mortality were 0.89 (0.84-0.92) for BISAP (within 24 h), 0.88(0.81-0.93) for Glasgow-Imrie (admission), 0.86(0.84-0.89) for APACHE II (within 24 h), and 0.86 (0.81-0.90) for Ranson (within 48 h). CONCLUSIONS: There is no evidence that any of the four scoring systems are better than another to predict SAP or mortality. The accuracy changes based on the time at which they are performed.
items.summary_cn: 该系统综述与荟萃分析纳入87项研究、65,942例患者，评估Ranson、Glasgow-Imrie、APACHE II和BISAP四种评分系统在急性胰腺炎入院48小时内预测重症急性胰腺炎和死亡率的准确性，发现四种评分系统之间无优劣之分，且准确性随评估时间点变化。

items.title_cn: TUDCA-3S与急性胰腺炎严重程度及促炎巨噬细胞活化相关，涉及S100A8/IL-17信号通路
items.title_en: TUDCA-3S is Associated with Acute Pancreatitis Severity and Pro-Inflammatory Macrophage Activation Involving S100A8/IL-17 Signaling
items.abstract_cn: 目的：早期识别有重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）风险的患者仍然具有挑战性，硫酸化胆汁酸代谢物对AP相关炎症反应的贡献仍不完全清楚。本研究探讨了血清TUDCA-3S与AP严重程度之间的关联，并在体外探索了其对炎症性巨噬细胞活化的影响。方法：研究队列包括100例急性胰腺炎（AP）患者和50例健康对照。采用靶向代谢组学定量检测血清TUDCA-3S水平，并评估其与疾病严重程度的关联及受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线性能。使用LPS刺激的RAW264.7炎症性巨噬细胞模型来检测与TUDCA-3S暴露相关的细胞反应。采用流式细胞术、RT-qPCR、Western blotting、转录组学、非靶向代谢组学、脂质组学及S100A8敲低进行进一步表征。结果：血清TUDCA-3S水平在研究组间存在显著差异，其中SAP患者的中位水平最高。TUDCA-3S区分AP患者与健康对照的AUC为0.873。然而，其区分严重程度的表现明显较低，MAP与MSAP比较的AUC为0.534，MAP/MSAP与SAP比较的AUC为0.714。在LPS刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞中，TUDCA-3S暴露与M1相关炎症特征增强及S100A8和IL-17A表达升高相关。S100A8敲低减弱了M1相关标志物和IL-17A的表达。转录组学、非靶向代谢组学和脂质组学分析进一步确定了与TUDCA-3S暴露相关的炎症和脂质代谢变化。结论：血清TUDCA-3S与AP及疾病严重程度相关，尽管其在不同AP严重程度分类间的区分性能仅为中等。体外研究结果支持TUDCA-3S暴露与促炎性巨噬细胞特征之间的关联，涉及S100A8相关的IL-17A信号通路和代谢重塑。这些发现具有探索性，需要独立的临床和实验验证。关键词：TUDCA-3S，S100A8，IL-17信号通路，M1巨噬细胞极化，急性胰腺炎
items.abstract_en: Objective: Early identification of patients at risk of severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) remains challenging, and the contribution of sulfated bile-acid metabolites to AP-associated inflammatory responses remains incompletely understood. This study investigated the association between serum TUDCA-3S and AP severity and explored its effects on inflammatory macrophage activation in vitro. Methods: The study cohort comprised 100 patients with acute pancreatitis (AP) and 50 healthy controls. Serum TUDCA-3S levels were quantified using targeted metabolomics, and associations with disease severity and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) performance were evaluated. An LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 inflammatory macrophage model was used to examine cellular responses associated with TUDCA-3S exposure. Flow cytometry, RT-qPCR, Western blotting, transcriptomics, untargeted metabolomics, lipidomics, and S100A8 knockdown were used for further characterization. Results: Serum TUDCA-3S levels differed significantly among the study groups, with the highest median level observed in patients with SAP. TUDCA-3S distinguished AP patients from healthy controls with an AUC of 0.873. However, its performance for severity discrimination was substantially lower, with an AUC of 0.534 for MAP versus MSAP and 0.714 for MAP/MSAP versus SAP. In LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages, TUDCA-3S exposure was associated with enhanced M1-related inflammatory features and increased S100A8 and IL-17A expression. S100A8 knockdown attenuated M1-associated markers and IL-17A expression. Transcriptomic, untargeted metabolomic, and lipidomic analyses further identified inflammatory and lipid-metabolic changes associated with TUDCA-3S exposure. Conclusion: Serum TUDCA-3S is associated with AP and disease severity, although its discriminatory performance across AP severity categories is limited to moderate. The in vitro findings support an association between TUDCA-3S exposure and pro-inflammatory macrophage features involving S100A8-associated IL-17A signaling and metabolic remodeling. These findings are exploratory and require independent clinical and experimental validation. Keywords: TUDCA-3S, S100A8, IL-17 signalling pathway, M1 macrophage polarisation, acute pancreatitis
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现血清TUDCA-3S水平在急性胰腺炎（AP）患者中显著改变，重症AP患者中位数最高，其区分AP与健康对照的AUC为0.873，但区分AP严重程度分级的效能仅为中等（MAP vs MSAP AUC 0.534，MAP/MSAP vs SAP AUC 0.714）。体外实验表明TUDCA-3S暴露与LPS刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞M1相关炎症特征增强及S100A8、IL-17A表达升高相关，S100A8敲低可减弱M1标志物和IL-17A表达。

items.title_cn: MAP和IAP联合轨迹定义重症急性胰腺炎的预后性腹腔灌注亚表型：死亡率差异及与早期液体暴露的关联
items.title_en: Joint trajectories of MAP and IAP define prognostic abdominal perfusion subphenotypes in severe acute pancreatitis: differential mortality and associations with early fluid exposure
items.abstract_cn: 重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）仍与较高的ICU死亡率相关，而早期液体管理仍存在不确定性。动态腹腔压力-灌注轨迹是否能识别可重复的预后亚表型，以及这些类别是否表现出不同的液体-结局关联，目前仍不清楚。在这项多中心观察性队列研究中，我们对1008例SAP成人患者（开发队列，2005-2023年）和独立外部队列中的315例患者（TRACE试验加南京金陵医院，2023-2024年）使用基于组的轨迹模型，联合建模了ICU第1-7天的平均动脉压（MAP）和腹腔内压（IAP）轨迹。多变量Cox模型比较了各亚表型之间的28天死亡率。滞后线性混合效应模型检验了预设时间点的液体量与下一次计划评估时后续MAP/IAP变化之间的关联；贝叶斯模型作为敏感性分析实施，以评估模型稳健性。五折折外（OOF）预测的第1天标签用于液体-死亡率关联的假设生成分析，敏感性分析比较了OOF预测标签与GBTM推导的轨迹分组。共识别出四种预后性腹腔压力-灌注亚表型（平均后验概率0.913）：稳定型（26.3%）、低灌注型（26.7%）、高血压失代偿型（18.1%）和高血压代偿型（29.0%）。28天死亡率分别为5.7%、17.8%、29.7%和8.2%（log-rank P < 0.001）；与稳定型相比，校正HR（95% CI）分别为4.35（2.16-8.74）、5.49（2.68-11.24）和1.55（0.71-3.40）。外部队列重现了死亡率排序（log-rank P = 0.005）。第t天液体量对下一次计划测量时ΔIAP表现出整体液体×亚表型交互作用（P = 0.007）；在高血压失代偿型类别中，每增加一升液体与IAP多增加0.40 mmHg相关（95% CI 0.23-0.57）。在一项次要探索性分析中，在第1天OOF预测的低灌注型类别中，更大的累积第1-2天液体量与更高的28天死亡率相关（校正HR每升1.26，95% CI 1.08-1.48；P = 0.004）；相应的整体液体×类别交互作用无统计学意义（P = 0.085）。共识别出四种具有不同28天死亡率的预后性腹腔灌注轨迹亚表型，在独立队列中具有相似的模式和死亡率排序。联合MAP-IAP轨迹可能有助于预后分层，而按类别分层的液体-结局关联因终点和标签来源而异，需要前瞻性验证。不适用（观察性研究）。外部验证包括TRACE试验（ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02473406）。
items.abstract_en: Severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) remains associated with substantial ICU mortality, while early fluid management remains uncertain. Whether dynamic abdominal pressure–perfusion trajectories identify reproducible prognostic subphenotypes and whether these classes exhibit distinct fluid–outcome associations remain unknown. In this multicentre observational cohort study, we jointly modelled mean arterial pressure (MAP) and intra-abdominal pressure (IAP) trajectories over ICU days 1–7 using group-based trajectory modelling in 1008 adults with SAP (development cohort, 2005–2023) and 315 patients in an independent external cohort (TRACE trial plus Nanjing Jinling Hospital, 2023–2024). Multivariable Cox models compared 28-day mortality across subphenotypes. Lagged linear mixed-effects models examined associations between fluid volume at prespecified time points and subsequent MAP/IAP changes at the next scheduled assessment; Bayesian models were implemented as sensitivity analyses to assess model robustness. Five-fold out-of-fold (OOF)-predicted Day-1 labels were used for hypothesis-generating analyses of fluid–mortality associations, with sensitivity analyses comparing OOF-predicted labels with GBTM-derived trajectory assignments. Four prognostic abdominal pressure–perfusion subphenotypes were identified (average posterior probability 0.913): Stable (26.3%), Hypoperfusion (26.7%), Hypertensive decompensated (18.1%), and Hypertensive compensated (29.0%). 28-day mortality was 5.7%, 17.8%, 29.7%, and 8.2% (log-rank P < 0.001); adjusted HRs (95% CIs) versus Stable were 4.35 (2.16–8.74), 5.49 (2.68–11.24), and 1.55 (0.71–3.40), respectively. The external cohort reproduced the mortality ranking (log-rank P = 0.005). Day-t fluid volume showed a global fluid × subphenotype interaction for ΔIAP at the next scheduled measurement ( P = 0.007); within the Hypertensive decompensated class, each additional litre was associated with a 0.40 mmHg greater increase in IAP (95% CI 0.23–0.57). In a secondary exploratory analysis, greater cumulative Days 1–2 fluid volume was associated with higher 28-day mortality within the Day-1 OOF-predicted Hypoperfusion class (adjusted HR 1.26 per litre, 95% CI 1.08–1.48; P = 0.004); the corresponding global fluid × class interaction was not statistically significant ( P = 0.085). Four prognostic abdominal perfusion trajectory subphenotypes with divergent 28-day mortality were identified, with similar patterns and mortality ranking in an independent cohort. Joint MAP–IAP trajectories may inform prognostic stratification, whereas class-stratified fluid–outcome associations varied by endpoint and label source and require prospective validation. Not applicable (observational study). External validation included the TRACE trial (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02473406).
items.summary_cn: 该多中心队列研究通过联合建模重症急性胰腺炎患者ICU第1-7天的MAP与IAP轨迹，识别出四种腹部灌注预后亚型（Stable、Hypoperfusion、Hypertensive decompensated、Hypertensive compensated），其28天死亡率分别为5.7%、17.8%、29.7%和8.2%，并在独立外部队列中重现了死亡率排序。此外，液体暴露与亚型间存在差异关联，如在Hypertensive decompensated亚型中每增加1升液体与IAP额外升高0.40 mmHg相关。

items.title_cn: 更多计算，有限获益：全身免疫炎症指数与更简单的血细胞计数衍生指数预测急性胰腺炎严重程度及短期死亡率的比较（一项系统评价和荟萃分析）
items.title_en: More calculation, limited gain: systemic immune-inflammation index versus simpler blood count–derived indices for predicting acute pancreatitis severity and short-term mortality (a systematic review and meta-analysis)
items.abstract_cn: 血细胞计数衍生的炎症指标是急性胰腺炎（AP）早期风险分层的可及候选工具，但全身免疫炎症指数（SII）是否比更简单的指标具有更优的独立判别能力尚不确定。我们评估了SII对AP严重程度和短期死亡率的预测价值，并将其与中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值（NLR）、血小板与淋巴细胞比值（PLR）和全身炎症反应指数（SIRI）进行直接比较。我们系统检索了MEDLINE/PubMed、Embase、Scopus和Google Scholar截至2026年7月的文献，纳入评估入院时或入院24小时内SII对急性胰腺炎严重程度或死亡率影响的成人研究。严重程度结局按修订版Atlanta标准和非Atlanta标准进行分层。采用随机效应荟萃分析合并AUC，基于阈值的敏感度和特异度采用双变量模型进行综合。SII与其他标志物在同一队列中的判别能力比较通过研究内AUC差异进行评估。异质性、偏倚风险和证据确定性分别采用I²、预后准确性研究质量评估工具和GRADE原则进行评价。共纳入25项研究，包含12，850名参与者。在19项严重程度研究（11，534名参与者）中，SII合并AUC为：修订版Atlanta标准重症AP为0.663（95% CI 0.514–0.786；I² = 66.4%），轻症与中重症/重症AP比较为0.724（0.578–0.835；I² = 91.9%），非Atlanta严重程度定义为0.713（0.653–0.766；I² = 46.5%）。在配对比较中，SII与NLR和SIRI的判别能力相似，但高于PLR（AUC差异 + 0.064）。5个一般AP队列（918名参与者；71例死亡）的合并死亡率AUC为0.796（0.591–0.914；I² = 66.8%），但研究间不确定性较大。死亡率比较数据稀少。与PLR比较的证据确定性为低，其他主要比较的证据确定性为极低。SII显示出依赖于定义且异质的判别能力。它未优于NLR或SIRI，在严重程度方面对PLR显示出适度的低确定性优势，且死亡率准确性不稳定。鉴于大部分证据基础存在高偏倚风险，当前证据不足以支持SII作为独立决策工具；在预设阈值经过前瞻性验证之前，其任何辅助作用仍不确定。PROSPERO，CRD420261464739。
items.abstract_en: Blood-count-derived inflammatory indices are accessible candidates for early risk stratification in acute pancreatitis (AP), but whether the systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) provides superior stand-alone discrimination compared with simpler indices is uncertain. We evaluated SII for AP severity and short-term mortality and compared it directly with the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR) and systemic inflammation response index (SIRI). We systematically searched MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase, Scopus and Google Scholar through July 2026 for adult studies evaluating admission or first-24-hour SII for acute pancreatitis severity or mortality. Severity outcomes were stratified by Revised Atlanta and non-Atlanta definitions. Random-effects meta-analysis pooled AUCs, while threshold-based sensitivity and specificity were synthesised using bivariate models. Comparative discrimination between SII and other markers measured in the same cohorts was assessed using within-study AUC differences. Heterogeneity, risk of bias and certainty of evidence were evaluated using I², the Quality Assessment of Prognostic Accuracy Studies tool and GRADE principles, respectively. Twenty-five studies included 12,850 participants. Across 19 severity studies (11,534 participants), pooled SII AUCs were 0.663 (95% CI 0.514–0.786; I 2 = 66.4%) for Revised Atlanta severe AP, 0.724 (0.578–0.835; I 2 = 91.9%) for mild versus moderately severe/severe AP, and 0.713 (0.653–0.766; I 2 = 46.5%) for non-Atlanta severity definitions. In paired comparisons, SII showed similar discrimination to NLR and SIRI but higher discrimination than PLR (AUC difference + 0.064). Five general AP cohorts (918 participants; 71 deaths) yielded a pooled mortality AUC of 0.796 (0.591–0.914; I 2 = 66.8%), although between-study uncertainty was substantial. Mortality comparisons were sparse. Certainty of evidence was low for the comparison with PLR and very low for the other principal comparisons. SII showed definition-dependent and heterogeneous discrimination. It did not outperform NLR or SIRI, showed a modest low-certainty advantage over PLR for severity, and had unstable mortality accuracy. Given the high risk of bias across much of the evidence base, current evidence is insufficient to support SII as a stand-alone decision tool; any adjunctive role remains uncertain pending prospective validation of prespecified thresholds. PROSPERO, CRD420261464739.
items.summary_cn: 该荟萃分析纳入25项研究共12,850例患者，发现SII对急性胰腺炎严重程度和短期死亡的预测能力呈定义依赖性且异质性较大，其判别力与NLR和SIRI相似，仅对PLR有低确定性的微弱优势（AUC差异+0.064），且死亡预测准确性不稳定。现有证据因偏倚风险高，不足以支持SII作为独立决策工具。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
